fieldDayDescription: Manage the working day independently for each Mobile, Fixed and Transit team. Select teams to enable or close their day together.
fieldDayWaitingHint: Your AIC must enable a working day and prepare your assignment before you can fill a sheet.
fieldDayNotReady: No ready assignment is available for the enabled day. Contact your AIC. Mobile teams work on Days 1–3.
fieldDayReadOnly: This sheet is read-only because its day is not currently enabled, or the working day could not be verified. Unsaved entries have not been moved to another day.
fieldDayDiscard: Opening another sheet will discard unsaved changes in this form. Continue?
fieldDayLoadFailed: Unable to load field days. Please try again.
fieldDayActiveOnly: Field days can only be managed while the campaign is Active.
fieldDayRequirements: Each team can have one enabled day. Enabling requires one assignment and a finalized Mobile OMP. Closing requires that team's sheets to be finalized; then its next day can be enabled. Mobile: Days 1–3. Fixed/Transit: Days 1–7.
fieldDayInitial: Initial setup: select the actual working day for this campaign. Existing sheets keep their original day.
fieldDayEnableConfirm: Enable Day {{day}} for the {{count}} selected team(s) listed below?
fieldDayCloseConfirm: Close Day {{day}} for the {{count}} selected team(s) listed below? They will no longer be able to edit this day's sheets.
fieldDayNoTeams: No eligible teams of this type for this day.
fieldDayAtomic: Only the listed teams will change. If any team fails validation, none of the selected teams will be changed.
fieldDaySelectionHint: Selection is limited to this page and clears when the day, filters, sort, page or page size changes. All selected teams must be eligible for the chosen action.
fieldDaySelectPage: Select eligible teams on this page
fieldDayNoMatches: No teams match this day and these filters.
